question: Which human, subtle, and cognitive groups are included in this part of the pratiṣṭhā compendium?
premises: The verse lists teachers, teacher-disciple pairs, seers, and groups beginning with Iḍā.
It includes the group of eight bodies and the world of modifications beginning with smell.
It also includes the eight qualities of intellect, ego-activity, and the qualities of sense objects.
inference: Pratiṣṭhā is populated not only by worlds but also by lineages, subtle channels, bodies, and cognitive-objective factors.
uncertainties: The precise referent of the group beginning with Iḍā is left implicit.
plain_english: There are teachers, teachers with disciples, groups of seers, and those beginning with Iḍā, together with the eight bodies. There is also the world of modifications beginning with smell, the eight qualities of intellect, ego-activity, and the qualities of the sense objects.
